the Al 2 As n − anions have a lower electron affinity than AlAs m − anions, but they are more stable than AlAs m− anions.
the Al n As 4 − ( n  =1,2) and Al 2 A 3 − anions are more stable in comparison with other Al n As m ( m  < 4) anions.
Al n As m ( n, m  =1, 2) anions exhibit a variety of structures, and their stability depends on the size of the cluster and the number of As atoms.

the electronic structure of semiconductor binary microcluster anion.
the structural, electronic state and the stability of the binary microclusters of Al n As m ( n  = m = 1)–Al 2 As 7 ( n  < 2, n  = m  =1–7) in the gas phase.
the structural and electronic properties of the AlAs m − anions and the Al 2 As n − anions.

the Al n As 2 n − ( n  =1,2) anions are the most stable.
the AlAs 4 and Al 2 (As) 3 anion is the most stable and the Al 2 As n − ( n  = m = 1 to 7) anion is less stable than the AlAs n − ( n = m = 1 to 7).
the Al n As 2 − and Al 3 As 2 − anions are the most stable ones.

the AlAs 4 and Al 2  As 3 are most stable anion, and AlAs 2, Al 2 As, Al 2 As n ( n  = 3, 5) and AlAs n ( n 3, 4, 7) are unstable.
